summary: Forafric Global PLC filed a Form 6-K on October 7, 2026, disclosing a letter of intent to acquire 100% of AL NASR Industries Systems, a recently formed Moroccan defense platform holding minority stakes in two licensed defense manufacturing ventures. No price per share, total consideration or premium was disclosed; expected closing is Q4 2026, subject to due diligence, definitive agreements, board approval based on final terms, and regulatory approvals. AL NASR is controlled by Forafric's ultimate beneficial owner, making this a related-party transaction. Watch related-party valuation fairness, Moroccan Law 10-20 licensing scrutiny, and whether a definitive deal or financing materializes.
